test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mohit and Rohit undertook a work for Rs. 6600. Mohit alone can do that work in 25 days. Rohit alone can do the same work in 30 days. They work together. What will be the difference in the amount (in Rs.) they receive?
solution:
**Given:**

Total money = ₹6600

Mohit = 25 days

Rohit = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Share ∝ Efficiency

**Calculations:**

LCM
 of 25
